Wrote Map — What C++ Is (D00, wave 0, pinned root map): derived the abstract-machine/as-if-rule/UB contract from first principles, concept map over 8 registered D00 topics, 8-step learning route, 7 mechanism-level Key Ideas. Back-wove into Map D04 (new opening link) and into RAII / Dangling Pointers (extended their existing Zero-Overhead Principle mentions to point at this map).
Wrote Map — Ownership & Move Semantics (D07): domain question, singular/shared-ownership tension, 14-node concept map, 14-step learning route, 9 key ideas; woven from Map D04 and RAII.

Wrote Map — Inheritance & Polymorphism (D08, wave 0): derives the domain's run-time-dispatch question from first principles, concept map hubbed on Virtual Dispatch, 14-step Learning Route and 8 Key Ideas covering is-a, vptr resolution, slicing, virtual destructors, ctor/dtor dispatch, name hiding, and the static/dynamic polymorphism contrast.

Wrote Map — Program Structure & Build (D01, wave 0): derives translation units as the domain hub from the one-file-at-a-time constraint; concept map of 14 registered topics; 13-step learning route; 8 key ideas incl. ODR exception (inline), linker semantics, static-init-order gap, and Modules as the domain's own compatibility-vs-evolution resolution. Sourced Primer §2.2.2/§6.1.3, Tour §3.2 (p.30-32), PPP §1.3-1.4/§4.4/§4.7, cppreference Phases of Translation + ODR, [lex.phases].

author: Map — Types & Values (D02) written from first principles (bits -> type as values x operations x representation), citing Primer/Tour/PPP/Pikus + cppreference + WG21 P0907R4 (C++20 two's-complement mandate); back-wove a forward link from Map — What C++ Is

deepen: depth + integration — added [dcl.ref]/[class.copy.assign] clause citations (reference collapsing, deleted copy-assign for reference members, dangling-reference UB, one-past-the-end pointer arithmetic), an Under the Hood section with verified GCC asm (sum_ref vs sum_ptr identical at -O2) and sizeof evidence, a 3rd compiled ill-formed code example, and a backlink from RAII's Prevents bullet

owner request: adopted the owner's 13 std-header sheets as Header Cards (05 Headers, HDR domain), hub map, 44 cards registered; header archetype, cc: stmts, export-pdf; originals + PDFs archived to __RESOURCES__
wave 0: wrote Map — Expressions & Control (D03), the third of 16 remaining domain maps; back-wove links from Map — Types & Values and Value Categories

Wrote Map — Functions (D05, wave 0): derives the naming/invocation problem from first principles, covers the call stack, parameter passing, overload resolution, lambdas/closures and callables under abstraction-vs-control and value-vs-identity tensions. Woven from Map — Expressions & Control and Map — Objects, Memory & Lifetime (already frontier-linked).

Wrote Map — Classes & Encapsulation (D06): derives the invariant/encapsulation problem from first principles, maps 13 of the domain's 18 registered topics (Classes as Types through Value Semantics), names abstraction-vs-control and value-vs-identity as the core tensions, and routes all 18 topics in the Learning Route. Woven in via existing prereqs/related links from Map — Functions, Map — Ownership & Move Semantics and Map — Inheritance & Polymorphism.

AUTHOR: Map — Generic Programming (D09), the compile-time counterpart to D08's run-time polymorphism. Derives templates from first principles, ties instantiation (the hub) to concepts/SFINAE/traits, cites Primer 651/675, Tour 103-105, PPP 18.1, Pikus 366, cppreference and [temp]. Already double-woven via D08's existing inbound links.

deepen: pointers-vs-references depth (rubric dim: depth, was 2/3) — added a Corner Cases subsection (polymorphism dispatches identically through references and pointers; identity vs value comparison for references; pointer relational comparison is unspecified, not UB, with std::less's total-order guarantee) plus a 4th verified code example and 2 quizzes; back-linked from Virtual Dispatch — vptr and vtable

Wrote Map — Standard Library (wave 0 domain map): derives the library from first principles (shared, zero-overhead answer to containers/algorithms/IO so programs interoperate), names abstraction-vs-control and compatibility-vs-evolution as the domain's tensions, draws a 13-node concept map hubbed on STL Architecture and Iterators, and routes through vector -> Iterators -> Algorithms -> associative/hash containers -> IO streams -> views/ranges -> vocabulary types. Already linked in from Map — Generic Programming, Map — Expressions & Control and Map — Standard Headers.

Wrote Map — Errors & Contracts (D11, wave 0): contracts as the domain hub, fanning into exceptions/error_code/expected, assertions, noexcept, stack unwinding, exception hierarchies, and the cost of exceptions. Woven into RAII and Map — What C++ Is.

map-d12: Map — Concurrency (frame: memory model as hub, safety-vs-performance + abstraction-vs-control tensions, Amdahl's Law price, 15-node concept map, 11-step route, 8 Key Ideas). Wove into Map — Ownership & Move Semantics (atomic ref-count tension) and RAII (jthread row).

Wrote Map — Performance & the Machine (D13, wave 0): derives the domain's question from D00's abstract-machine contract, covers memory hierarchy, pipeline/branch prediction, compiler optimization and UB-as-optimization-license, data locality/data-oriented design, allocation cost and SIMD. 14-node concept map hubbed on Big-O Meets the Hardware. Back-wove into Map — Objects, Memory & Lifetime (new related link + forward pointer); Map — Concurrency already linked here. Next: map-d14, map-d15, map-d16.
